facilitator.heading: Become a workshop facilitator
facilitator.intro: Help bring The Discovery Program to life for children in Mumbai - through play, stories and real conversation, never lectures.
whatYouDo: Run our board-game-led sessions (about 1 hour 40 minutes) with children aged 5–16
Bring our games, stories and scenarios to life and keep a room of kids engaged
Hold warm, safe space for honest conversations about feelings, fairness and body safety - kind, never preachy
Work within our trauma-informed, safeguarding-first approach at all times (a home or school staff member is present in every session)
whatWeLook: Warm, patient and genuinely good with children
Comfortable improvising and holding a group’s attention
Comfortable facilitating in both English and Hindi
You challenge ideas, never shame the child
Free on your chosen weekend mornings, and able to travel within Mumbai
process: Fill in the form below with your details and preferred day.
Have a conversation with our founders.
facilitator.formIntro: Tell us a little about yourself and pick the weekend morning you’d like to help with.
